text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Midway through summer camp. After posting 
a 4-panel comic to my blog, I checked the 
access stats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The website traffic that peaked around the 
Oka Sho is gradually settling down, but 
it's still significantly higher than when 
we first started.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gearing myself up once more, I head toward 
the training grounds, when—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: How is it, delicious?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was treated to a meal by Hishi Amazon, 
the big-sister-type Umamusume and dorm 
leader of Miho Dorm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *chew*... *chew*. Yeah, I can eat this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Hishi Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. More importantly, promise me 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare try to go to training 
without eating just because you don't have 
an appetite!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was able to run with no problems 
yesterday even without eating, right?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meaning she skipped meals yesterday while 
training... —The color instantly drains 
from my face.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Hello.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...What is the matter? You've gone 
completely pale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I completely failed to notice Aston 
Machan's loss of appetite. Without Hishi 
Amazon's support, it could have turned 
into a serious issue.
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry for causing you trouble due to 
my shortcomings...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hold on. Did Chan-chan not 
mention to you that she had summer 
fatigue?"
choice_data_list:
That's true, but I still should have 
noticed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Should I have noticed...? Is that really 
so?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about the food for now! I 
basically just made it on the side anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... Chan-me! Come over 
here a sec.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen to me. I might sound like a 
nag, but promise me this."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Things like whether you're feeling good or 
bad, and our plans going forward, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you properly talk to your 
Trainer about important things like that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...? Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Trainer is your partner, isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Partner.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Someone who solves all kinds of problems 
that happen in the Twinkle Series together 
with you. That's what kind of presence 
they are.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's not something you should take 
lightly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Umm... So... is that how it is?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah. Someday, you'll understand."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (...Hishi Ama-san said that, but...)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, in the end, I believe Chan-me's 
problems are hers and hers alone.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—It's done, I did it. It turned out to be 
my most beautiful painting ever!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. I really want someone to see this—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"—The scarf is finished. It's the first 
time in my life I've ever completed one. 
It's all thanks to you teaching me."

text_block_list.name: Inpatient T
text_block_list.text:
""...Ah. Machan. You worked so hard. But 
I'm sorry. I just wasn't feeling well 
today—""

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Look...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Did ×××-san go to a much, much 
bigger hospital?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "...Is that so? I wasn't aware."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"XX was discharged from the hospital. XXXX 
resigned from the company. X and XXX went 
to the beach."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"We won't be able to see each other 
anymore, will we?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Our speed, distance, and depth are 
different. I cannot remain beside you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This is only natural. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I painted a beautiful picture.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Was that good, then?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Yes, that is a relief.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The boat only seats one. One descends 
alone, tossed secretly in the raging 
currents as one drifts out to sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... that's why...—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It should be the same for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's not something you should take 
lightly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ………… ……Neglected.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “...... What do you mean by 'neglected'?”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Is Mar-chan being mean to Trainer, 
perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Aston Machan, who was 
supposed to have the day off from 
training, came to visit me with a 
remarkably formal demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go out somewhere? Either 
to the sea, or the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I have to understand. So... first, which 
one do you like?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We're going to the mountains to, um... 
search for the most powerful stag beetle.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We're going to the sea... um, to search 
for the sea cucumber with the most guts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not entirely sure why... but I 
happened to be stuck on ideas for the 
4-panel manga anyway. So—
choice_data_list:
Off to the mountains to find a powerful 
stag beetle!

To the sea, to search for a sea cucumber 
with true guts.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, you prefer the mountains. 
Understood, let us go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Natsumi, the big-pincered stag beetle. 
Who's the strongest one around here?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-huh, uh-huh. I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Apparently she doesn't know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we spent the day like that, night had 
completely fallen before we even realized 
it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, you wish to see the sea. I know a 
special spot. Let us go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Reporting our progress, Expedition Leader.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Found them. Mr. Jewelryfish the jellyfish, 
and Mr. Snippy the crab.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The sea cucumber is... not yet. Urgh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we spent the day like that, the sun had 
completely set before we knew it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It has gotten quite late, hasn't it? 
...The stars here are sparkling so 
brightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, as I was jotting down 
Aston Machan's words and actions from 
today in my notes before I forgot—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...? What are you doing? Is that a diary?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking of using it as material for 
a 4-panel comic.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The 4-koma comic... Even on a day off like 
this, you're still drawing for us.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan understands Trainer-san a little bit 
better now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you really are passionate about 
your work, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, if I only viewed this as 
"work," I wouldn't spend my days off 
drawing 4-koma manga, but—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I learned plenty. It turned out to be a 
wonderful summer day. ...Fufu, that's one 
step forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to just leave it at that.
